categories.main_business_segments: Cousins Properties operates primarily in two business segments: Office and Non-Office. The Office segment consists of Class A office properties in major Sun Belt markets, while the Non-Office segment includes mixed-use developments, retail, and multifamily properties, though these are a small portion of the portfolio. The company’s operations are further segmented geographically, with a focus on Atlanta, Austin, Charlotte, Phoenix, Tampa, Dallas, and Nashville.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Cousins specializes in the development, acquisition, leasing, and management of Class A office buildings, utilizing industry best practices in property management, sustainable building design (including LEED and BOMA 360 certifications), and energy efficiency. The company employs a disciplined approach to capital allocation, leveraging local operating platforms and advanced building systems to maximize operational efficiency and tenant satisfaction.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are corporate tenants across diverse industries, with a concentration in technology, professional services, financial, legal, and energy sectors. Major tenants include NCR Corporation, Amazon, Meta Platforms, Expedia, and Pioneer Natural Resources. The company’s properties serve large, creditworthy tenants seeking high-quality office space in urban Sun Belt markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: Cousins’ portfolio is concentrated in the Sun Belt region of the United States, with major holdings in Atlanta, Austin, Charlotte, Phoenix, Tampa, Dallas, and Nashville. Atlanta and Austin are the largest markets, representing the majority of net operating income, followed by Charlotte, Tampa, and Phoenix. The company also holds select assets in other markets such as Chapel Hill and Houston.
categories.supply_chain_position: Cousins operates as a downstream player in the commercial real estate supply chain, focusing on the ownership, development, leasing, and management of office properties. The company does not engage in construction contracting or raw material supply but partners with contractors and service providers for development and property operations.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on owning and developing premier urban office portfolios in high-growth Sun Belt markets, with an emphasis on disciplined capital allocation, sustainability, and operational excellence. R&D efforts are directed toward sustainable building practices, energy efficiency, and leveraging technology for property management and tenant experience. The company also pursues selective development, opportunistic acquisitions, and timely dispositions to optimize its portfolio.
categories.revenue_model: Cousins generates revenue primarily through rental income from operating leases with tenants in its office properties, including base rent and tenant reimbursements for operating expenses. Additional revenue streams include development, management, and leasing fees from joint ventures and third parties, as well as gains from property and joint venture sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Cousins competes with other office REITs, real estate developers, institutional investors, and private equity firms in the Sun Belt markets. Key competitors include large public office REITs and regional real estate owners. Cousins positions itself as a leading owner of Class A office properties in high-growth markets, with a reputation for quality, sustainability, and strong tenant relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2021, Cousins owned interests in 18.9 million square feet of office and other space, with total assets of $7.3 billion and annual rental property revenues of $739 million. The company reported net income available to common stockholders of $278.6 million and funds from operations (FFO) of $409.2 million in 2021. Growth is driven by acquisitions, selective development, and strong leasing activity, with a conservative balance sheet and low leverage relative to peers.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Cousins differentiates itself through its focus on premier, sustainable, and efficient Class A office properties in dynamic Sun Belt markets, offering tenants high-quality space, operational excellence, and access to amenities and transit. The company emphasizes sustainability, energy efficiency, and community engagement, which enhances tenant retention and attracts high-credit tenants. Its disciplined capital allocation and local market expertise further strengthen its competitive position.
